# RhineLabUI opening port

Source: https://github.com/LBEILC/RhineLabUI
Pinned commit: 12cc5e4013acb9408f753ff71de6b8492299b7c8
Copyright (c) 2026 LBEILC, MIT License.

BootSequence, motion tracks, logo geometry and fixed phrase artwork are retained
from this source. Relative TypeScript imports use explicit extensions for the
local verifier. theme-ui and asset-url are small host adapters. CSS is scoped
to the opening stage to avoid affecting collection pages. The original optional
webfont kit is disabled; the source's authored SVG phrase drawings are used.
The standalone opening controller, readiness gate, replay/skip controls and
transition into Pass Archive are local integration code.

The logo and demo phrases recreate a fictional Rhine Lab terminal. They do not
perform authentication. Original game-related rights remain with their owners.
Third-party typeface rights remain with Jan Tonellato / Synthview; font binaries
are not included. The fixed graphic phrases and their notice are preserved.
